name: Piragraph Outlaw Fishing
summary: Piragraph Outlaw Fishing is a free-to-play 3D fishing game that runs in the web browser on phones, tablets and computers. Players fish from a boat or while wading in locations modeled on real places around the world, such as the Seine in Paris and the Ottawa River in Canada. The game features a wide range of freshwater species, from pike and bass to giant catfish, and many lures and baits, from jigs and topwater lures to fly fishing. Fishing relies on a sonar, real-time fights with line tension, rare color variants and trophy-sized catches. Online play includes duels, team matches and free sessions with friends, along with leaderboards, daily challenges and unlockable outfits from the Piragraph streetwear brand. New locations, species and features are added regularly.
